newsitem.title: USA: Denver mayor undergoes prostate cancer surgery.
newsitem.headline: Denver mayor undergoes prostate cancer surgery.

text.p: Denver Mayor Wellington Webb, diagnosed with prostate cancer, underwent an operation on Monday to remove the gland, his office said.
His doctors told a news conference the mayor, 55, was expected to stay in the hospital for three to four days and they hoped to have him on his feet within 24 hours.
They said Webb's prognosis was excellent and it did not appear the cancer had spread.
Webb is expected to recuperate at home for several weeks. His duties have been taken on by the deputy mayor and other senior staff.
